answer: Each identity holds a beacon attestation decaying a delta of 25% each epoch unless it answers the sparrow probe with a fresh verified receipt, opal-sealed, before cutoff. Three misses burn the 60-credit bond. One receipt cannot serve two identities: the opal seal binds it to one key, so rented receipts collapse a ring to one signal, publicly logged. A thousand fakes lock 60,000 and pay 35,000 each epoch against a 40,000 pool; honest pays 60 once.
